div.div: أُطُمٌ and أُطْمٌ, (S, K,) like أُجُمٌ and أُجْمٌ, (S, and Mgh in art. اجم) A fortress: or, as some say, any lofty building: (Mgh:) or a [building such as is termed] قَصْر [q. v.]: (IAar, K:) and any fortress built of stones: and any square, roofed, house: (K:) pl. (of pauc., TA) آطَامٌ (S, Mgh. K) and (of mult., TA) أُطُومٌ: (K:) آطَامٌ signifies fortresses of the people of El-Medeeneh: and one of these is termed ↓ أَطَمَةٌ : (S:) or this signifies [simply] a fortress; and its pl. is آطَامٌ (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
